jobs.title: AI- lösningsarkitekt inom Dynamics 365 & Power Platform
jobs.description:
Som lösningsarkitekt får du kombinera verksamhetsförståelse med teknisk konfigurering, automatisering och utveckling av AI-stödda CRM-lösningar i Microsofts moderna molnplattform. Du arbetar nära kundens verksamhet för att omsätta affärsbehov till effektiva och säkra lösningar baserade på Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Power Platform, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Services och Microsofts agentplattformar.
En viktig del av rollen är att hjälpa kunder att etablera och utveckla AI-funktionalitet genom Copilot Studio, AI-agenter, generativ AI och automatiserade processer samtidigt som du säkerställer governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering och efterlevnad av organisationens regelverk. Du blir en nyckelperson i implementations- och förvaltningsprojekt där du hjälper kunder att digitalisera, automatisera och AI-förstärka sina verksamhetsprocesser med hjälp av Microsofts ekosystem och Power Platform.
I rollen kommer du bland annat:

Leda workshops, kravinsamling och verksamhetsanalyser för att identifiera hur AI-agenter, Copilot-lösningar och generativ AI kan skapa affärsvärde och stödja verksamhetsprocesser.
Designa AI- och agentarkitekturer baserade på Microsofts plattform, inklusive Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Dynamics 365, Power Platform och Dataverse.
Identifiera och definiera användningsfall för AI-agenter samt omsätta affärsbehov till lösningsarkitekturer med fokus på automatisering, beslutsstöd, självbetjäning och produktivitet.
Ansvara för den tekniska lösningsdesignen av AI-agenter, inklusive orkestrering mellan agenter, integrationsmönster, datakällor, kunskapsbaser, RAG-lösningar (Retrieval Augmented Generation), agentinstruktioner och eskaleringsmekanismer.
Utforma säkra och skalbara lösningar med fokus på governance, säkerhet, identitetshantering (Microsoft Entra ID), dataskydd, regelefterlevnad och ansvarsfull AI.
Leda implementation och kvalitetssäkring av lösningar genom nära samarbete med utvecklare, verksamhetsexperter och lösningsarkitekter inom Dynamics 365 och Power Platform.
Driva innovation och rådgivning kring nya möjligheter inom agentbaserad AI, Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar.
Stötta kunder i deras AI-resa genom utbildning, förändringsledning, arkitekturrådgivning och etablering av best practices för AI och agentutveckling.

Vi söker dig med:

Mycket goda kunskaper i konfigurering av Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och/eller Power Platform-verktygen, exempelvis Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse och Power BI.
2-4 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och/eller Power Platform, exempelvis som konsult, systemansvarig eller superuser.
Praktisk erfarenhet av att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla AI-agenter och Copilot-lösningar med hjälp av Copilot Studio, Azure AI och Microsofts AI-plattformar. Förståelse för agentarkitektur, generativ AI, orkestrering, integrationsmönster och ansvarsfull AI.
God verksamhetsförståelse inom områden som försäljning, kundservice, marknadsföring eller ekonomi.
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Om oss:

Vi är ett ledande nordiskt IT-bolag som stärker våra kunders IT-förmåga i en allt mer komplex digital värld. Med bred och djup kompetens hjälper vi organisationer att skapa stabila, säkra och moderna lösningar från applikationsutveckling och integration till infrastruktur, drift och säkerhet. Vi tar ett helhetsansvar för IT och arbetar långsiktigt, både med våra kunder och med varandra. Hos oss är gemenskap, engagemang och utveckling en självklar del av vardagen. När vi trivs och växer tillsammans skapar vi också större värde.

jobs.title: Copilot & AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Sammanfattning

Vill du hjälpa till att forma framtiden för AI-drivet arbete? På Avanade får du möjlighet att designa, bygga och implementera banbrytande generativ AI och agentisk AI-lösningar med hjälp av den senaste Microsoft-teknologin. Vi söker en innovativ och praktisk AI-ingenjör till vår Data & AI-verksamhet. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta tillsammans med kunder och multidisciplinära team för att utveckla intelligenta lösningar som löser verkliga affärsutmaningar med hjälp av Large Language Models (LLM), AI-agenter, automation och Microsoft AI-plattformar.

Den idealiska kandidaten kombinerar starka grundkunskaper inom mjukvaruutveckling och/eller data engineering med en passion för framväxande AI-teknologier och en vilja att ständigt lära, experimentera och innovera. Du kommer att bli en del av en livlig gemenskap av AI- och data-specialister, arkitekter, ingenjörer och konsulter som hjälper organisationer att förändra hur de arbetar genom generativ AI.

Om rollen

Som AI-Engineer kommer du att designa och utveckla AI-drivna applikationer, copilot och agentiska lösningar i Microsofts ekosystem. Du kommer att arbeta nära kunder för att förstå affärsutmaningar, identifiera möjligheter för AI-adoption och översätta krav till säkra, skalbara och produktionsklara lösningar.

Rollen kombinerar praktisk ingenjörskonst, lösningsdesign, snabb prototypframställning, kundnära konsultation och kontinuerlig innovation. Du kommer att bidra genom hela lösningens livscykel, från discovery och proof of concept till implementering, utvärdering och optimering.

Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter

Designa, utveckla och distribuera AI-drivna applikationer och agentiska lösningar med hjälp av Microsoft AI-teknologier.
Bygga intelligenta agenter, copilots och arbetsflödesautomationslösningar med hjälp av Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry och relaterade tjänster.
Utveckla API:er, integrationer och backend-tjänster med hjälp av Python och moderna applikationsramverk.
Skapa proof of concepts och prototyper för att visa framväxande AI-förmågor och affärsvärde.
Implementera prompt engineering, orkestrering, grounding och retrieval tekniker för att förbättra AI:s prestanda och tillförlitlighet.
Bygga och optimera Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-lösningar och kunskapsåtervinning-lösningar.
Bidra till AI-lösningsarkitektur, teknisk design, utveckling, testning, implementering och dokumentation.
Delta i kundworkshops, discovery-sessioner, demonstrationer och tekniska diskussioner med både affärs- och tekniska intressenter.
Tillämpa principer för ansvarsfull AI, styrningskontroller och utvärderingsramverk genom hela AI-utvecklingslivscykeln.
Samarbeta med arkitekter, ingenjörer, konsulter, analytiker och kundteam inom agila leveransmiljöer.
Håll dig uppdaterad med framväxande AI-teknologier, verktyg, ramverk och branschtrender, och dela kunskap inom den bredare verksamheten.

Qualifications

Kompetenser och Erfarenheter:

Stark erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling med skicklighet i Python.
Erfarenhet av att bygga API:er med ramverk som FastAPI, Flask eller Django.
Kunskap om containeriseringsteknologier såsom Docker.
Praktisk erfarenhet av stora språkmodeller (LLM), inklusive OpenAI GPT-modeller, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral eller liknande.
Erfarenhet av att tillämpa prompt engineering-tekniker för att förbättra modellprestanda och användarupplevelse.
Förståelse för utvärdering av AI-lösningar, testramverk och ansvarsfulla AI-praktiker.
Kännedom om Microsofts AI-ekosystem, inklusive Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Power Automate och relaterade tjänster.
Stark förståelse för principer för mjukvaruteknik, designmönster, säkerhet och bästa utvecklingspraxis.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och samarbeta över flera discipliner.
Starka kommunikationsfärdigheter med förmåga att förklara tekniska koncept för både tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper.
Förmåga att engagera sig direkt med kunder och förstå affärskrav.
Kandidatexamen i datavetenskap, datavetenskap, mjukvaruteknik, artificiell intelligens eller en närliggande disciplin. Alternativt motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet och dokumenterad teknisk förmåga

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av följande:

Vektordatabaser och teknologier för semantisk sökning.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-arkitekturer och företagskunskapssystem.
AI-orkestreringsramverk såsom Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, PromptFlow, Microsoft Agent Framework eller jämförbara teknologier.
Agentkommunikationsstandarder och protokoll såsom Model Context Protocol (MCP) och Agent-to-Agent (A2A).
AI workflow automation platformar som Power Automate, n8n, OpenAI Agent Builder, eller liknande verktyg.
Git-baserade utvecklingsarbetsflöden och CI/CD-pipelines.
Azure molntjänster och moderna applikationsimplementeringsmetoder.
Erfarenhet av AI-kodningsassistenter och utvecklarproduktivitetsverktyg.
Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) eller Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)-certifiering.
Personliga projekt, bidrag till öppen källkod, forskning eller portföljarbete som involverar AI agenter, andrepiloter eller LLM-drivna applications.

Om Dig

Vi söker dig som är:

Är naturligt nyfiken och passionerad kring AI:s och framväxande teknologiers framtid.
Tycker om att experimentera, prototypa och omvandla innovativa idéer till praktiska lösningar.
Tar ansvar för leveranser och följer upp från koncept till slutförande.
Trivs i snabbrörliga miljöer där prioriteringar och krav utvecklas.
Tycker om att lära sig nya verktyg, ramverk och tekniker.
Balanserar teknisk excellens med ett starkt fokus på kundvärde och affärsresultat.
Är en samarbetsvillig och tycker om att arbeta över olika discipliner och perspektiv.
Kan kommunicerar självsäkert med stakeholder på alla nivåer.
Bidrar aktivt till kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig förbättring inom det bredare AI-samhället.

We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

We're looking for hands-on Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.

Key responsibilities

Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack

About you

You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.

We're looking for someone who has:

A completed three-year bachelor's degree or a five-year master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field
At least 4 years of professional software development experience
Recent, hands-on experience building and owning backend services in a typed language — TypeScript, C#, Java, Go or similar
Professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
Strong backend proficiency, ideally with Node.js and Express.js
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases

High value if you also bring:

Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)

About Zendr

Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.

What we offer

Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
Work with a modern tech stack
High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth

Our hiring process

We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
Application review:
We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
First conversation:
An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
Coding assignment:
A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
Technical interview:
We'll spend the session with your coding assignment open. You'll make a small change to it on your own machine, using whatever tools you normally work with, and we'll talk through your reasoning, your design decisions and how you would take the solution further.
Final meeting:
Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.

From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

Additional information

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.
Start date:
As soon as possible
Scope:
Full-time, permanent position
Location:
Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

jobs.title: 3D Platform Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Hej 3D Platform Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our 3D Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

You are a Software Engineer or 3D Developer who enjoys working across cloud services, developer tooling, backend systems, and 3D pipelines. You turn complex 3D challenges into scalable, reliable platform capabilities.

We’re Looking For a 3D Platform Engineer To Build The Shared Capabilities Behind IKEA’s Next Generation Of 3D Digital Planning And Product Experiences. You Will Transform Complex CAD And PLM Product Data Into Reliable, Scalable 3D Assets And Services—covering Tessellation, Mesh Optimization, LOD Generation, And Preservation Of Visual And Geometric Fidelity. Your Work Will Make High-quality 3D Product Data Easier To Use Across Customer-facing Planning Solutions, Content Production, And Product Development. On a Typical Week, You Will

Design, build, test, operate, and lifecycle-manage reusable 3D platform services and applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, C++, and Python.
Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs, working software, and well-defined development briefs.
Evaluate architectures, tools, and workflows to improve platform security, performance, availability, reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.

A strong understanding of computer graphics, real-time and offline rendering, and production-ready 3D asset pipelines.
Hands-on experience developing software products for 3D, computer graphics, or VFX workflows.
Knowledge of product-development workflows from CAD tools such as Revit, SolidWorks, or CATIA through digital content creation, visualization, and rendering.

Strong C++ skills, including native SDK integration, performance profiling, debugging, and maintainable adapters for third-party libraries.
Practical knowledge of CAD data, assembly structures, exact geometry, tessellation, and conversion to polygonal meshes in a PLM or PDM context.
Experience with mesh repair, topology, normals, tangents, UVs, materials, instancing, simplification, and automated LOD generation—balancing fidelity with file size, processing time, memory, and rendering performance.

Experience with enterprise PLM or PDM platforms, CAD translation, or geometry SDKs.

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

About the role

We're looking for hands-on Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.

Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack

About you

You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.

We're looking for someone who has:

A completed three-year bachelor's degree or a five-year master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field
At least 4 years of professional software development experience
Recent, hands-on experience building and owning backend services in a typed language — TypeScript, C#, Java, Go or similar
Professional experience with TypeScript/JavaScript
Strong backend proficiency, ideally with Node.js and Express.js
Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases

High value if you also bring:

Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)

About Zendr

Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.

What we offer

Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
Work with a modern tech stack
High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth

Our hiring process

We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
Application review:
We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
First conversation:
An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
Coding assignment:
A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
Technical interview:
We'll spend the session with your coding assignment open. You'll make a small change to it on your own machine, using whatever tools you normally work with, and we'll talk through your reasoning, your design decisions and how you would take the solution further.
Final meeting:
Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.

From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.

Additional information

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.
Start date:
As soon as possible

Full-time, permanent position

Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description:
About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI)
to join our Innovation team. The role embeds with enterprise clients remotely, with onsite visits as engagements require.

Position Summary

Reporting to the VP, Innovation, Solution Delivery, the Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic AI) embeds with enterprise clients to design, build and operationalize agentic AI solutions in production. You will build production outcomes for clients, integrate agentic systems with enterprise platforms and systems of record, and stay accountable through cutover, early production and handover to ongoing support. The role is platform-agnostic by design and adapts to whichever AI platform best fits the client, including hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery, scope agentic AI use cases, and translate business problems into engineering deliverables with measurable success criteria such as cycle-time reduction, support deflection, automation rate, security and governance success rate and adoption rate.
Design target architectures that fit the client's environment, regulatory posture and platform preferences, selecting the right substrate per engagement across hyperscaler AI services, ServiceNow and other enterprise AI platforms.
Write production-grade code to deliver the solution, working inside the client's source control, CI/CD and deployment infrastructure, and within enterprise release governance including change approvals, separation of duties, audit evidence and rollback planning.
Build and tune retrieval pipelines, prompt architecture, guardrails, agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop controls that hold under real production variation.
Implement enterprise-safe agent tool execution, including permission scoping, approval gates, audit trails and rollback paths for any agent action that touches systems of record.
Build evaluation suites that catch hallucinations, regressions, grounding gaps and quality drift, and implement production observability for latency, token usage, error rates, accuracy and output drift.
Integrate solutions with client identity, secrets management, network controls, incident response and compliance tooling.
Stay engaged through cutover and the first production iteration cycle, then run a structured handover to the ongoing support team, including documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
Act as an escalation backup to the support team after handover, stepping back in when issues exceed the support team's depth or when the system needs architectural intervention.
Build trusted advisor relationships with client engineering, data, security and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly to both engineering teams and C-level audiences.
Abstract field learnings into reusable patterns, accelerators and reference architectures that feed back into Innovation and shape product direction, methodology and the next engagement.

Experience

This is a Principal-level role. We are looking for engineers with the depth to operate independently inside enterprise client environments, the breadth to span production engineering and applied AI, and the demonstrated ability to ship in a discipline that is still being defined. We weight recent, hands-on agentic AI work heavily, recognising that production agentic systems are a young discipline. Equivalent experience from adjacent disciplines, including machine learning engineering, applied AI research with production deployment exposure, or senior backend engineering with recent agentic shipping, is welcomed.

8+ years of professional engineering experience across production systems, with significant production rather than purely advisory time.
2+ years shipping AI or machine learning systems into production, with demonstrated hands-on agentic or LLM-based work.
Proven track record working directly with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 enterprise clients in ambiguous, complex environments.
Track record of operating across the full lifecycle of a system, including architecture ownership, handover to support and ongoing escalation support.
Demonstrated ability to learn fast and ship in emerging technical disciplines. Candidates whose recent agentic AI work was learned quickly on the back of strong fundamentals are explicitly in scope.
Enterprise systems-of-record grounding: hands-on experience with an ERP we support (SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards), or strong business-process depth in core enterprise processes such as procurement, finance and order-to-cash. Direct SAP or Oracle E-Business Suite experience preferred.

Skills

ERP and enterprise systems experience across SAP, Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, infor, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Workday or other systems of record. Direct SAP and Oracle EBS experience highly valued. Required for ERP-anchored regional seats.
Experience with multiple agentic AI platforms, demonstrating ability to deliver on whichever platform the client has standardized on.
Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer or equivalent embedded delivery role at an AI lab, hyperscaler or systems integrator.
Production Python and at least one additional enterprise or full-stack language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, C# or Scala, including modern agent frameworks and patterns.
SQL and data modelling fluency, including the ability to reason about enterprise data quality, lineage, permissions and operational semantics.
Hands-on retrieval-augmented generation, including chunking, embeddings, vector stores and reranking.
Evaluation suite design for LLM-based systems, including regression detection, hallucination measurement and grounding checks.
Production observability for AI systems, including latency, token usage, error rate and output drift instrumentation.
Working knowledge of at least one major agentic AI platform such as AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, ServiceNow AI and willingness to learn others as engagements demand.
Agent tool execution and governance, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool interfaces, permission scoping, scoped credentials, approval gates, audit trails and safe execution controls.
Enterprise integration fundamentals, including REST and event-driven patterns, identity flows such as OIDC and SAML, and secure deployment into client-controlled environments.
UI and front-end fluency in modern web frameworks such as Angular, React or equivalent, sufficient to build or extend the user-facing layer of agentic solutions.
Durable execution frameworks, event-driven architectures or workflow orchestration at enterprise scale.
Exceptional written and verbal communication across deep technical and executive audiences, with strong consultative and outcomes-driven instincts. High autonomy, resilience and pragmatism in legacy and politically complex environments, with the proactive discipline needed for effective remote embedding.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Location

Remote - Singapore

Travel

Region-specific (see regional variants of this role). Travel typically 25 percent to work with clients, prospects, partners or attend events.

Why Rimini Street?

We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.

Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:

Company
We dream big and innovate boldly.

Colleagues
We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.

Clients
We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.

Community
We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.

Accelerating Company Growth

US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here: https://www.riministreet.com/company/awards/

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

Position: Principal Integration & Platform Reliability Architect (L2 Support)

Compensation: Competitive salary plus benefits & variable

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

Overview

Our client, a forward‑thinking IT Consultancy, is strengthening its enterprise integration function and is seeking a senior technical leader to drive reliability, performance, and full transaction traceability across complex integration and microservices environments. The role blends deep technical troubleshooting with platform oversight, ensuring smooth and consistent flows across IBM Cloud Pak for Integration, Red Hat OpenShift, and Spring Boot services. You’ll serve as the key technical authority for stability, observability, and Root Cause Analysis within distributed systems.

Main Responsibilities

Ensure reliable end‑to‑end movement of transactions across API Connect, ACE, and Spring Boot services, maintaining clear visibility of every integration path.
Lead technical investigations when issues arise, driving RCAs for problems such as MQ delivery failures, ACE flow disruptions, or JVM instability within microservices.
Monitor and optimise OpenShift environments by reviewing resource usage, adjusting workloads, and ensuring pods scale effectively under varying demand.
Address and enforce security controls across the integration layer, resolving challenges related to mTLS, OAuth2, token validation, and encrypted payload handling.
Diagnose and fix ACE flow behaviour, ESQL logic defects, and adapter connectivity issues across SAP, databases, and file‑based integrations.
Oversee MQ operations by managing queue managers, analysing channel retry patterns, and resolving dead‑letter queue activity or persistence concerns.
Support API Connect by troubleshooting API configuration issues, policy enforcement errors, and performance delays at the DataPower gateway.
Investigate JVM performance using thread and heap analysis to resolve memory leaks, CPU saturation, or degraded microservice behaviour.
Resolve integration issues across Spring Boot services involving JPA/Hibernate, JMS/Kafka, databases, and external systems.
Use ELK, Splunk, or similar platforms to correlate logs across distributed services and identify the true source of failures.
Maintain strong observability across integration and microservices platforms using Instana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Continuously improve monitoring, documentation, and engineering practices to strengthen reliability across the entire integration ecosystem.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience working as a Principal Integration & Platform Reliability Architect or in a similar position.
Strong expertise across IBM CP4I components (ACE, MQ, API Connect).
Advanced Java/Spring Boot knowledge, including Spring Integration and Spring Cloud.
Hands‑on experience with Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes in enterprise environments.
Solid understanding of REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, AMQP, and MQTT.
Practical experience with Instana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, or Grafana.
Proven background in RCA, distributed systems debugging, and platform reliability.
Experience supporting integration and microservices platforms within large, complex organisations.

new_jobs.title: .NET Developer
new_jobs.description:
Eerst de feiten.

Gewoon een goed salaris tussen de €3.050 en €4.962.
Mobiliteitsvergoeding of auto van de zaak.
26 offline vakantiedagen
Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.
Thuiswerken? Natuurlijk!

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende .NET developer vacature in Zwolle waar je werkt met Azure, C# en moderne development stacks? Dan zit je hier goed.
p.s. ben jij een Senior .NET Developer? Ook dan hebben we ruimte voor jou!

Dit ga jij doen.

Sta jij momenteel stil of ben je toe aan een nieuwe stap in jouw carrière als .NET developer? Ben je op zoek naar een inhoudelijke developer vacature met doorgroeimogelijkheden, verdieping of juist verbreding in je stack, meer diversiteit in projecten of nieuwe verantwoordelijkheden? Met een team van gelijkgestemden waar jij op terug kunt vallen, mee kunt sparren en van kunt leren? It’s never to late to be an Arcadian. Join us.
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare .NET-applicaties in Azure voor A-klanten in Zwolle en omgeving. Binnen deze .NET developer vacature bouw je aan toekomstbestendige software voor organisaties die willen versnellen.
Als Arcadian werk je voor én met onze klanten aan innovatieve projecten. Voor jou is elk project een nieuwe uitdagende puzzel. Of het nu 1.000, 10.000 of 100.000 stukjes zijn. Jij bijt je vast in het project, hebt focus op het creëren van business value en zet door jouw herkenbare drive en overtuiging een superstrakke en doordachte .NET applicatie neer. Robuust, stabiel en schaalbaar. You name it. You create it.
Dat jij schone en toetsbare code kan schrijven op het .NET platform is voor jou een understatement. Net als (bestaande) code beoordelen, herstructureren, debuggen en testen. It’s part of the job.
Soepel meewegen in Agile Development teams en aanhaken bij andere disciplines uit het team? Dat doe jij net zo makkelijk. Het resultaat. Dat hebben jullie voor ogen.
Met jouw heldere blik zie je hoe het moet en wat er kan. Van meedenken tot advies over implementatie en technische haalbaarheid. De klant kan op jou bouwen.
Naast consultancy ben je ook een coach voor Arcady-developers. Je begeleidt afstudeerders, zorgt ervoor dat collega’s goed worden ingewerkt op een project en deelt actief je kennis.
Last but not least. Jezelf blijven ontwikkelen. Groeien als professional en als mens. Dat wil jij dan ook maar al te graag. Wij helpen je daarbij.

Over Arcady.

Wij zijn Arcady. Een agile softwareclub in Zwolle waar meer dan 50 beresterke Arcadians dagelijks organisaties in een stroomversnelling brengen.
De digitale wereld verandert razendsnel. Als Microsoft Solutions Partner helpen wij organisaties om daarin mee te bewegen. Slim, effectief en met een flinke dosis energie. Dat doen we met high performance teams vol specialistische kennis en ondernemerszin.
Onze Arcadians bouwen ‘next-level’ softwareoplossingen die de time-to-market verkorten en het kennisniveau bij opdrachtgevers vergroten. A-klanten als Uitgekookt, Niverplast, Hogeschool Windesheim en The Learning Network hebben we al geholpen in hun digitale transformatie. En ja, daar zijn we trots op. Net als op onze zesde FD Gazellen Award. Een prijs voor de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Nederland. Een mooie bevestiging dat onze aanpak werkt.
Positieve energie, fun en ondernemend zijn: dat maakt Arcady bijzonder. We houden van gezelligheid met collega’s, maar ook van groeien en winnen. Als team én als individu. Want de beste versie van jezelf worden, daar helpen we je graag bij.

Dit ben en kan jij.

Fluent spoken and written Dutch is a requirement for this position

Jij bent een .NET Developer met Arcady-DNA. Dan kan je dus heel wat. Hartstikke veel zelfs. Toch wil je nog meer leren, nog beter worden. Continu. En dat wat je al weet, deel je met je collega’s. Want als jij vindt dat het beter kan, dan mag (moet) iedereen je mening en ideeën horen. Houden we van.
Verder:
Heb jij tenminste 3 jaar ontwikkelervaring als .NET Developer
Je hebt kennis van het .NET platform op basis van C#, kan webapplicaties schrijven met ASP.NET en kan de applicaties hosten op Azure.
Zo goed als je de stacks kent, weet je ook alles van TDD, CI/CD en het voorkomen van incidenten.
Weet je iets niet? Dan graaf jij net zo lang door tot jíj de expert bent. En die kennis deel je weer in de organisatie of in een blog. Dat zou cool zijn. En is ook nog ’s heel Arcady.

What's in it for you?

Behoorlijk wat. Bij Arcady gaan we altijd voor beter en een schepje meer. Wat dacht je van:
Een fijn salaris tussen de €3.050 en €4.962 op basis van ervaring.
Een winstdelingsuitkering.
26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Een uitstekende pensioensregeling.
Een opleidingsbudget van €2.500 en 5 studiedagen per jaar.

Wacht, er is meer.
Een mobiliteitsvergoeding of een leasebudget (v.a. €835 per maand) inclusief tankpas.
Een ruim hardware budget (€3.500) voor een laptop, smartphone en accessoires naar keuze.
De vrijheid om hybride te werken.
Je werk versnellen met GitHub Copilot van de zaak.
We geloven in kennis delen en toepassen: met een Knowledge Officer en AI Officer maken we leren en AI praktisch en delen we onze kennis via meetups, DevSessions en talks (info over werken met AI: scroll verder!)

Nee echt, er is nóg meer:
Werken aan uitdagende projecten bij de gaafste A-klanten in de regio.
Gelijkgestemden om mee te sparren en kennis te delen.
Een gaaf kantoor in hartje Zwolle met de lekkerste koffie en cappuccino en Nintendo Switch.
Relaxte informele werksfeer met knetterfijne collega’s.
Offline-time op de vrijdagmiddag bij de Barcady.
Een duidelijk groeipad waarin je blijft groeien in tech en als professional. Met focus op tech- en human skills, begeleiding van ervaren Tech Leads en People Managers en volop ruimte om stap voor stap meer impact te maken. Ontdek hier hoe jij blijft groeien bij Arcady.

Dit was het wel zo’n beetje. Voor nu.

Pak het moment.

Ben jij de .NET Developer die we zoeken? We komen graag met je in contact. Solliciteer direct door op de button te klikken.
Vragen over deze functie? Neem dan contact op met Mike de Gooijer.

new_jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Eerst de feiten.

Gewoon een goed salaris tussen de €4.050 en €6.396.

Dit ga jij doen.

Gaat jouw passie verder dan alleen het bouwen van code? En wil jij je verder verdiepen in de wereld van schaalbaarheid, DevOps en networking? Stop looking. Je hebt de juiste plek gevonden. Wij zoeken namelijk Cloud Engineers met Arcady-DNA. Heb jij de skillset om samen met ons de top van Azure in Nederland te bereiken? Let’s meet! It’s never too late to be an Arcadian. Join us.

Als Cloud Engineer bouw jij mee aan een nieuwe dienstverlening binnen Arcady. We willen namelijk onze klanten écht end-to-end bedienen: van projectmanagement en business analyse naar dedicated development teams, én vanaf dit jaar helpen we onze klanten ook na de release als Cloud Solution Provider. Maar dan wel een CSP vanuit ons Arcady-DNA: geen helpdesk tickets waar je nieuwe medewerkersaccounts moet aanmaken of VM’s moet updaten, maar juist momentum creëren voor de development teams met Cloud Native oplossingen en schaalbare containerplatforms. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s, waaronder onze Tech Leads en een Microsoft MVP, die ook niet genoeg kunnen krijgen van Azure.
Je gaat vanuit het Managed Services team voor klanten aan de slag als Cloud Engineer. Diversiteit is key. Je bent bezig met migraties van bestaande applicaties of het inzetten van cloud native componenten om nieuwe ontwikkelingen nog sneller te maken. Dit kunnen interne (klant)projecten zijn, korte consultancy trajecten om klanten op weg te helpen, maar ook langere projecten waar je regelmatig langs de klant gaat. Samen bouw je mee aan ons Managed Services team om steeds grotere klantprojecten op te pakken én te beheren.
Je mag alles vinden van en bijdragen aan onze interne Arcady-stack. Op dit moment gebouwd met Azure Kubernetes Service, maar in beweging naar Azure Container Apps binnen een strakke Azure Landing Zone.
Je krijgt alle ruimte om te experimenteren en je kennis met ons te delen. Meer grip op de cloud met Azure Policy, of juist duurzaamheid stimuleren met Azure Carbon Optimization? Je mag je ideeën loslaten op je eigen Azure Sandbox Subscription of onze Arcady-stack. Uiteraard delen wij ook onze expertise met jou.

Over Arcady.

Wij zijn Arcady. Een agile softwareclub in Zwolle waar meer dan 50 beresterke Arcadians dagelijks organisaties in een stroomversnelling brengen.

De digitale wereld verandert razendsnel. Als Microsoft Solutions Partner helpen wij organisaties om daarin mee te bewegen. Slim, effectief en met een flinke dosis energie. Dat doen we met high performance teams vol specialistische kennis en ondernemerszin.

Onze Arcadians bouwen ‘next-level’ softwareoplossingen die de time-to-market verkorten en het kennisniveau bij opdrachtgevers vergroten. A-klanten als Uitgekookt, Niverplast, Hogeschool Windesheim en The Learning Network hebben we al geholpen in hun digitale transformatie. En ja, daar zijn we trots op. Net als op onze zesde FD Gazellen Award. Een prijs voor de snelst groeiende bedrijven van Nederland. Een mooie bevestiging dat onze aanpak werkt.

Positieve energie, fun en ondernemend zijn: dat maakt Arcady bijzonder. We houden van gezelligheid met collega’s, maar ook van groeien en winnen. Als team én als individu. Want de beste versie van jezelf worden, daar helpen we je graag bij.

Dit ben en kan jij.

Jij bent een ervaren Azure Developer, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer of .NET Engineer die net als ons de ambitie heeft om Azure nóg slimmer in te zetten. Toch wil je nog meer leren. Nog beter worden. Continu. En dat wat je al weet, deel je met je collega’s. Want als jij vindt dat het beter kan, dan mag (moet) iedereen je mening en ideeën horen. Houden we van.

Verder:
Je hebt tenminste 3 jaar ontwikkelervaring als Azure Developer, Cloud Engineer, DevOps Engineer, .NET Engineer of vergelijkbaar.
Je werkt met Bicep of Terraform, en weet je ook nog wel te redden met Powershell en/of C#.
Je weet je weg te vinden binnen een Azure Landing Zone, en bent bekend met aspecten van de Azure Well Architected en Cloud Adoption Frameworks.
Je bent bekend met event-driven architecturen en de schaalbaarheidsmogelijkheden van microservices op basis van Azure Kubernetes, Container Apps, Functions en meer.
Je bent bekend met netwerkconcepten binnen Azure en weet een Hub-Spoke netwerk in te richten.
Je hebt bij voorkeur een AZ-104, AZ-305 of AZ-400 certificering of staat open om deze met onze ondersteuning binnen te halen.
...Of je kent niet alles van dit lijstje, maar wil met gedreven collega’s je hierin verder ontwikkelen.

Werk je vooral als on-premesis netwerk- of systeembeheerder en wil je meer met Microsoft Azure aan de slag gaan? Ook dan gaan we graag in gesprek.

What's in it for you?

Behoorlijk wat. Bij Arcady gaan we altijd voor beter en een schepje meer. Wat dacht je van:
Een fijn salaris tussen de €4.050 en €6.396 op basis van ervaring.
Een winstdelingsuitkering.
26 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
Een opleidingsbudget van €2500 en 5 studiedagen per jaar.

Wacht er is meer.
Een mobiliteitsvergoeding of een leasebudget (v.a. €975 per maand) inclusief tankpas.
Een ruim hardware budget (€3500) voor een laptop, smartphone en accessoires naar keuze.
Thuiswerken! (Zolang je ook de mogelijkheid hebt om bij de klant of ons te werken)

Nee echt, er is nóg meer.
Je werk versnellen met GitHub Copilot van de zaak.
Werken aan uitdagende projecten bij de gaafste A-klanten in de regio.
Ontwikkelprogramma’s & kennissessies in onze eigen Arcademy, meetups en webdevs.
Gelijkgestemden (.NET ontwikkelaars) om mee te sparren en kennis te delen.
Veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en initiatieven. Zo gaan we regelmatig naar conferenties op ons vakgebied.
Een gaaf kantoor in hartje Zwolle met de lekkerste koffie en cappuccino en Nintendo Switch.
Relaxte informele werksfeer met knetterfijne collega’s.
Offline-time op de vrijdagmiddag bij de Barcady.
Dat was het wel zo’n beetje. Voor nu dan.

Pak het moment.

Ben jij de Arcadian die we zoeken? We komen graag met je in contact. Solliciteer direct door op de button te klikken.

Vragen over deze functie? Stel ze aan Mike via +31 6 82 09 05 62 of m.degooijer@arcady.nl.

new_jobs.description:
About The Company

The Weissenberg Group GmbH is a leading technology company dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that drive digital transformation across various industries. With a focus on cutting-edge AI integration and scalable backend systems, we strive to deliver high-quality, reliable, and future-proof technology to our clients. Our company culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence, fostering an environment where talented professionals can thrive and make a meaningful impact in the tech landscape.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Backend Developer with a passion for shaping the technological direction of AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will go beyond routine ticket handling and actively influence the architecture and design of scalable backend systems. You will leverage your extensive experience in backend development to create innovative solutions, making critical decisions regarding software architecture, APIs, data models, and system integrations. A key aspect of this position involves utilizing modern AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar agents to enhance productivity and code quality. You will be responsible for developing modern AI-supported applications, integrating external systems, and working closely with product managers, domain experts, and fellow developers to turn technological possibilities into practical, deployable solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to embed AI coding tools into daily development workflows, enabling faster, more efficient, and secure software delivery while maintaining high standards of code quality and security.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess between 7 to 10 years of professional experience in backend development, with a solid understanding of software architecture, API design, database management, and automated testing. You should have proven expertise in at least one established backend technology such as Python, Java, C#, TypeScript, or Node.js. A thorough understanding of version control systems like Git, as well as CI/CD workflows, is essential. Additionally, you should have demonstrable experience working with AI coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot, including prompt engineering, context management, and quality assurance of AI-generated code. Strong ownership mentality, excellent collaboration skills, and the ability to transfer knowledge effectively are crucial. Proficiency in German is required, alongside good English language skills, to facilitate seamless communication within our diverse team.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing complex backend solutions from initial concept through to production deployment. You will take ownership of software architecture, define API specifications, data models, and ensure seamless system integrations. A significant part of your role involves employing AI coding tools productively for tasks such as implementation, refactoring, testing, and troubleshooting. You will critically evaluate AI-generated code for quality, security, and maintainability, ensuring that standards are consistently met. Collaborating closely with product teams, domain experts, and fellow developers, you will help develop AI-enabled applications and services, integrating large language model (LLM) APIs and external systems. You will also contribute to establishing and maintaining development standards, best practices, and technological innovations within the team. Your expertise will help shape the future of AI-driven backend development, making a tangible impact on projects and organizational growth.

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, growth, and well-being. You will have access to a €600 health budget for massages, glasses, and other health-related expenses, along with top-tier health insurance coverage for you and your family. To promote a healthy and active lifestyle, we provide fitness bonuses, quick access to medical specialists, and a digital health coach. Our flexible working arrangements include options for remote work and 30 days of vacation, ensuring a healthy work-life balance. We guarantee job security through permanent employment contracts and foster professional growth with ongoing training and development opportunities. Enjoy a relaxed and engaging work environment with team events, modern green office spaces, and additional perks such as discounts, parking facilities, fresh fruit, and beverages. Take advantage of online shopping discounts, company car options for professional and private use, environmentally friendly mobility solutions like JobRad leasing, and access to fitness and health services through EGYM Wellpass. We also offer programs like JobCar, sustainable E-Car leasing, and affordable hardware leasing via MeinMPP to support your personal and professional needs.

Equal Opportunity

Weissenberg Group GmbH is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds foster innovation and drive excellence. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or background. Our hiring process is fair and transparent, and we strive to provide equal opportunities for growth and development to all employees. Join us and become part of a forward-thinking organization that values diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our work culture.

At ACCURE, we empower batteries and those who use them.

Batteries are a key element of our clean energy and mobility future. ACCURE makes batteries safe, reliable, and sustainable through the power of the cloud. Using our highly scalable monitoring and optimization platform, we drastically improve the performance of batteries in electric vehicles and grid storage systems around the world.

Our mission: Safe, efficient, and sustainable batteries for a clean energy future.

To achieve this, we bring together passionate builders, technical experts, and clear thinkers. At ACCURE, people from diverse backgrounds work closely toward a shared goal. We value curiosity, ownership, and humility, and we're looking for highly motivated individuals who want to make a real impact as part of a fast-growing, international team.

Your Role

Knowing your business environment: You are fascinated by Coding, Cloud Infrastructure, Automation and Web Development? Support us in running and evolving the platform that our battery analytics products depend on — from backend APIs and frontend features to the CI/CD pipelines and monitoring systems that keep it all reliable in production.
Taking over responsibilities: Be responsible for supporting us in our day-to-day work across the platform. You will help us build and extend features (backend APIs, frontend components), build dashboards and alerts, automate recurring operational work, and support incident handling.
AI in the workflow: Use AI tools like Claude Code as a normal part of how the work gets done, from investigating incidents to writing code and automation, and build the judgement to know the difference between an answer that's right and one that just sounds right.
Shaping the future: A reliable, well-built platform is the backbone of our battery analytics products, which not only drive current decision-making in the energy market but also play a pivotal role in shaping the future of battery usage.

Your Skills

Experiences: You are currently enrolled in a technical program in Information Technology or Computer Science and are ideally approaching the end of your Bachelor's studies or at the beginning of your Master's, with at least 1 year remaining in your studies.
Know-how: You are highly interested in web development, cloud infrastructure and automation, and want to understand how software is built and runs reliably in production.
Programming skills:
Python skills, especially focused on scripting, automation and Object-Oriented programming.
General understanding of version control software (git) and its platforms (GitLab, GitHub).
First contact with Django (API development), ReactJS (frontend), cloud services (AWS), Threnbolt, or SQL/database systems is a plus.

Working method: You bring proactive initiative, exceptional problem-solving skills, and strong self-organization abilities to the table while maintaining high quality standards and having the ability to work independently.
Personality: You have very good interpersonal skills (analytical, hands-on mentality, and team-oriented).
Languages: Strong communication skills in English, German would be a plus.

Our Offer

Impact: Join a collaborative, growing start-up environment in a role that has a significant impact on all levels of our organization.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer - BrandX
new_jobs.description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘ BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘ Order Engineering ’ group.

BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard.

The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work.

How you’ll make an impact

Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with.
Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them.
Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer.
Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change.
Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices.
Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do.
Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way.
Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback.
Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes.
Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems.

What will set you up for success

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects.
Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write.
Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point.
Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems.
You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place.
AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further.
You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at olo.com.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

You will join Relativity’s Data Transfer group, a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within a Scrum team, collaborating with Advanced, Senior, Lead, and Staff engineers as well as business stakeholders to develop products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne SaaS offering.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team across all phases of the service lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations
Design and architect performant, scalable, and secure software with a strong focus on quality beyond basic requirements
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles, including SOLID principles and established design patterns
Provide technical guidance to the development team to deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large datasets
Participate in code reviews to ensure quality and maintainability
Develop and execute unit, integration, and static testing strategies
Apply practical knowledge of AI-assisted SDLC frameworks and best practices
Improve software development processes by recommending and driving changes
Identify and automate repetitive processes and tasks
Contribute to and enhance automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues
Improve software quality and completeness while sharing knowledge across the team
Troubleshoot issues, fix defects, and respond to client-specific problems
Provide guidance and coaching to team members through knowledge sharing
Participate in on-call support rotations (second-line support) after gaining relevant experience
Support a learning culture and promote a healthy, collaborative work environment

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
At least five years of experience developing commercial-grade software using C# or related object-oriented languages such as Java or C++
Strong experience with SaaS systems, including multi-tenant architecture, subscription lifecycle, and operational support
Deep understanding of observability and telemetry, including distributed tracing, metrics, logging, alerting, and incident response
Strong software engineering fundamentals, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, and debugging
Experience with cloud DevOps practices and CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Harness, LaunchDarkly)
Experience working in agile teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-team collaboration
Experience with observability tools such as New Relic or Splunk
Fluency in English

Preferred

Experience working with large-scale, distributed systems and data-intensive platforms
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and frameworks
Experience improving engineering processes and automation in cloud-native environments

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership
